item_name: Missing Entry in the Uniform Assessment System for NY (UAS-NY)
lookback_notes: NOT_FOUND. The protocol's Area 11 states a required frequency for the UAS-NY entry ("upon a change of condition or at least every 6 months") but does not state an assessor observation/look-back window in days ending on an assessment reference date. (A 7-day look-back is stated only for the Patient Review Instrument in Area 30, p. 18, which is a different item and applies to service dates prior to 03/01/2015.)

federal_coding_rules.rule: A UAS-NY entry is required upon a change of condition or at least every 6 months.

source.quote: The Uniform Assessment System for NY (UAS-NY) is required upon a change of condition or at least every 6 months.

federal_coding_rules.rule: If the UAS-NY is missing from the patient online file, the claim will be disallowed.

case_mix_relevance.notes: Area 11 does not tie the missing-UAS-NY finding to a payment or case-mix classification; it states outright claim disallowance. (A related but separate area, Area 12 on p. 10, references a generated RUGS Group Code, but that is a different audit area and is not extracted here.)

conflicts.topic: Applicable service-date range printed on the Area 11 page versus the protocol's earlier-service-date section

positions.claim: The page containing Area 11 is headed for service dates 01/01/2013 through 10/31/2025.

source.quote: (For Service Dates 01/01/2013 through 10/31/2025)

positions.claim: Separate pages of the same protocol cover findings for service dates 01/01/2013 through 02/28/2015 that were phased out per NYS DOH Medicaid Update, February 2013, Vol. 29, No. 3, while Area 11's own footnote says it was phased in per the same Medicaid Update.

source.quote: Findings below phased out as per NYS DOH Medicaid Update, February 2013, Vol. 29, No. 3

conflicts.resolution: unresolved — surface to user; the document does not state how the phase-in of Area 11 and the phase-out of the pre-03/01/2015 findings overlap for service dates 01/01/2013–02/28/2015.
